title: Fleet: recorded flights as virtual vehicles

options.content: **Fleet of virtual vehicles.** Each recorded ULog file plays as its own virtual PX4 and sends MAVLink to the same gateway a physical PX4 would use (ADR-0060). Rows marked *replay of recording* are recordings, not live aircraft. **Connection** is *observed* while that vehicle's heartbeat arrived in the last 3 s and the gateway and serving reports are current; *stale* when it falls silent (a paused player); *ended* when its file is over; *unknown* when the gateway or serving report is missing. A value the file does not contain stays Unknown; the player's own heartbeat never becomes a recorded state.

panels.title: Vehicles
panels.description: One row per declared vehicle, from fleet_state.

targets.rawSql: SELECT label AS Vehicle, if(kind = 'ulog-replay', 'replay of recording', 'live PX4') AS Source, connection AS Connection, ifNull(replay_status, '-') AS Player, round(source_receipt_age_ms / 1000, 1) AS `Receipt age (s)`, facts AS Positions, round(altitude_msl_m, 1) AS `Altitude MSL (m)`, round(ground_speed_m_s, 1) AS `Ground speed (m/s)`, round(voltage_v, 2) AS `Voltage (V)`, round(remaining_fraction * 100) AS `Battery (%)`, multiIf(armed IS NULL, 'unknown', armed = 1, 'armed', 'disarmed') AS Armed, ifNull(refusal, '') AS Refusal FROM ${database}.fleet_state ORDER BY system_id SETTINGS readonly=1,max_execution_time=10,max_threads=1,max_memory_usage=268435456,max_rows_to_read=50000,max_bytes_to_read=64000000,read_overflow_mode='throw',max_result_rows=4096,max_result_bytes=4194304,result_overflow_mode='throw'

panels.title: Tracks and last positions
panels.description: One point per native second per vehicle; the larger marker is the last position while observed. No external tiles.

targets.rawSql: SELECT vehicle_label AS label, system_id, tupleElement(argMin(tuple(latitude_deg, longitude_deg), native_time_boot_ms), 1) AS latitude, tupleElement(argMin(tuple(latitude_deg, longitude_deg), native_time_boot_ms), 2) AS longitude FROM ${database}.points GROUP BY vehicle_label, system_id, intDiv(native_time_boot_ms, 1000) ORDER BY system_id LIMIT 4096 SETTINGS readonly=1,max_execution_time=10,max_threads=1,max_memory_usage=268435456,max_rows_to_read=50000,max_bytes_to_read=64000000,read_overflow_mode='throw',max_result_rows=4096,max_result_bytes=4194304,result_overflow_mode='throw'

SELECT label, system_id, latitude_deg AS latitude, longitude_deg AS longitude FROM ${database}.fleet_state WHERE latitude_deg IS NOT NULL SETTINGS readonly=1,max_execution_time=10,max_threads=1,max_memory_usage=268435456,max_rows_to_read=50000,max_bytes_to_read=64000000,read_overflow_mode='throw',max_result_rows=4096,max_result_bytes=4194304,result_overflow_mode='throw'

panels.title: Altitude MSL by vehicle
panels.description: Latest altitude per vehicle in each receipt-time bucket of the selected range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(toInt64(max(received_unix_ms))) AS time, vehicle_label AS vehicle, tupleElement(argMax(tuple(altitude_msl_m), tuple(received_unix_ms, input_offset)), 1) AS value FROM ${database}.points WHERE received_unix_ms BETWEEN ${__from} AND ${__to} GROUP BY system_id, vehicle_label, intDiv(received_unix_ms - ${__from}, intDiv(${__to} - ${__from}, 512) + 1) ORDER BY time, vehicle SETTINGS readonly=1,max_execution_time=10,max_threads=1,max_memory_usage=268435456,max_rows_to_read=50000,max_bytes_to_read=64000000,read_overflow_mode='throw',max_result_rows=4096,max_result_bytes=4194304,result_overflow_mode='throw'

panels.title: Battery remaining by vehicle
panels.description: Latest sample per vehicle in each receipt-time bucket of the selected range. An unknown battery reading leaves a gap.

targets.rawSql: SELECT fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(toInt64(max(received_unix_ms))) AS time, vehicle_label AS vehicle, tupleElement(argMax(tuple(remaining_fraction * 100), tuple(received_unix_ms, input_offset)), 1) AS value FROM ${database}.points WHERE received_unix_ms BETWEEN ${__from} AND ${__to} GROUP BY system_id, vehicle_label, intDiv(received_unix_ms - ${__from}, intDiv(${__to} - ${__from}, 512) + 1) ORDER BY time, vehicle SETTINGS readonly=1,max_execution_time=10,max_threads=1,max_memory_usage=268435456,max_rows_to_read=50000,max_bytes_to_read=64000000,read_overflow_mode='throw',max_result_rows=4096,max_result_bytes=4194304,result_overflow_mode='throw'
